title_zh: 约好先核实邻店的耐阴植物存货

scenario.label_zh: 约好先核实邻店的耐阴植物存货
scenario.goal_zh: 说明植物的摆放条件，并约定店员查询邻近苗圃后再告知是否有货

context_zh: 在采用英式拼写的虚构园艺商店中，顾客询问适合遮阴阳台的植物。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Eileen
sentences.text: I need a plant for a balcony that gets only occasional sunshine. Everything on this shelf says full sun.

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: We’re low on shade plants today. The neighbouring nursery may have a better choice.

sentences.speaker: Eileen
sentences.text: Could you check before I go there? I don’t drive, so it’s quite a trip.

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: Of course. I’ll call them and ask what they have for a mostly shaded balcony.

sentences.speaker: Eileen
sentences.text: Thank you. I’ll look at the pots while you make the call.

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: I’ll come and find you when I have an answer.
